newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai PTT buys 78,000t Oct fuel oil from Subic Bay.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT buys 78,000t Oct fuel oil from Subic Bay.

text.p: State-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) has bought by tender a total of 78,000 tonnes of fuel oil from Subic Bay Petroleum Ltd, industry sources said on Friday.

The price for 70,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent sulphur fuel oil was around $9.00 per tonne above Singapore spot quotes, on a cost and freight (c-and-f) basis to Sri Racha, while 8,000 tonnes of 1.0 percent sulphur fuel oil was purchased at a $15-to-$16 per tonne premium, c-and-f.
The cargoes are for October 26-30 deliveries.
Subic Bay Petroleum is a joint venture between U.S. Coastal Corp and PTT.
In September, PTT purchased 70,000 tonnes of 2.0 percent sulphur grade fuel oil at $9 per tonne over Singapore quotes for deliveries in the first half of September.
It also purchased 10,000 tonnes of 1.0- percent sulphur fuel oil at $16 per tonne over Singapore quotes for first half September.
